full_judgment: ii. Whether the High Court Division committed an error of law in holding that the suit was not maintainable as it disclosed no cause of action because the plaintiff did not give any date of refusal to execute the sale deed by the predecessor of the defendants in that the cause of action for filing suit has been disclosed in the suit which was from 18.11.1981 and the bainapatra having specified 30th Agrahayan of 1390 BS as the specified date for performance of the contract, the limitation for filing the suit for specific performance of the contract under Article 113 of the Limitation Act was to commence from that date and not from the date of refusal and, therefore, whether the judgment and decree of the High Court Division are not maintainable in law.
